Our story

Cooking with the seasons

Saffron & Sage began as a twelve-seat kitchen with one simple idea: cook what the season gives us, and cook it well. Today our menu still changes with the market, built around produce from nearby farms, fish landed the same morning and bread baked in-house every day.

Our chefs keep things honest — a handful of good ingredients, open-fire cooking and a generous pinch of saffron where it belongs. Whether you drop in for a quick lunch or settle in for a long dinner with friends, we want every plate to feel like it was made just for you.

  • Local Produce from farms within 50 miles
  • Seasonal A menu that changes every month
  • Fire Breads and mains from our wood oven
